content.text: Let me write a generator that constructs a sequence with proper complementary pairs at all target base-pair positions, then test it.

input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import subprocess, json
t='((((......(((((...))).((....)).........)).....))))'
# 0-indexed base pairs
pairs=[(0,49),(1,48),(2,47),(3,46),(10,40),(11,39),(12,20),(13,19),(14,18),(22,29),(23,28)]
comp={'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}
# build sequence with GC for outer+middle stems, strong hairpin stems; A-rich loops
s=['A']*50
# outer stem: G-C
for i,j in [(0,49),(1,48),(2,47),(3,46)]:
    s[i]='G'; s[j]='C'
# stem at 10-40, 11-39: G-C
s[10]='G'; s[40]='C'
s[11]='C'; s[39]='G'
# hairpin1 stem 12-20,13-19,14-18: GGG-CCC
s[12]='G'; s[20]='C'
s[13]='G'; s[19]='C'
s[14]='G'; s[18]='C'
# hairpin1 loop 15,16,17: AAA
s[15]='A'; s[16]='A'; s[17]='A'
# hairpin2 stem 22-29,23-28: G-C, G-C
s[22]='G'; s[29]='C'
s[23]='G'; s[28]='C'
# hairpin2 loop 24,25,26,27: AAAA
for k in [24,25,26,27]: s[k]='A'
# multiloop & bulge: positions 4,5,6,7,8,9 (between outer stem and middle stem)
for k in [4,5,6,7,8,9]: s[k]='A'
# position 21 between hairpin1 close and hairpin2 open
s[21]='A'
# multiloop 30-38
for k in range(30,39): s[k]='A'
# bulge 41-45
for k in range(41,46): s[k]='A'
seq=''.join(s)
print('SEQ',seq,'LEN',len(seq))
# verify pairs
for i,j in pairs:
    assert comp[seq[i]]==seq[j], (i,j,seq[i],seq[j])
print('all pairs OK')
EOF
